columns.name: campaign_criterion_criterion_id
columns.comment: The ID of the criterion. This field is ignored during mutate.

columns.name: campaign_criterion_bid_modifier
columns.comment: The modifier for the bids when the criterion matches. The modifier must be in the range: 0.1 - 10.0. Most targetable criteria types support modifiers. Use 0 to opt out of a Device type.

columns.name: campaign_criterion_campaign
columns.comment: The campaign to which the criterion belongs.

columns.name: campaign_criterion_display_name
columns.comment: The display name of the criterion. This field is ignored for mutates.

columns.name: campaign_criterion_negative
columns.comment: Whether to target (`false`) or exclude (`true`) the criterion.

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.comment: The name of the campaign. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new campaigns. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.
